items.name: Every landing on Mars
items.blurb: From Viking 1 in 1976 to Perseverance and Zhurong in 2021: where the landers and rovers came down, and what each one found.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: Ring of Fire
items.blurb: Nine volcanoes around the Pacific rim, from Antarctica to Japan, with the plate boundary that feeds them. Turn on the earthquake layer to see it working.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: The Apollo landing sites
items.blurb: Six landings, 1969 to 1972, from the Sea of Tranquility to the Taurus-Littrow valley. A tour of where people walked on the Moon.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: The Silk Road
items.blurb: Xi'an to Constantinople along the northern route: nine caravan cities, the deserts and passes between them, and the line of the road as an overlay.
items.author: Shell:B
